title: TEAMMATE SEES RICOCHETS
why: A round that ricochets off steel (v26.66) bounced only in the window that fired it. The teammate got one tracer at fire time, which died at the wall, so he saw the round stop on the steel and then maybe a damage number or a kill with no visible source, and never saw the spark or heard the ping. Proven in the fixture: the shooter window sends 1 tracer word for a bounced round, and the teammate tracer dies 3 frames in with its flight unturned. Now the bounce sends a second tracer word, flagged, from the bounce point (one extra word per round at most); the teammate draws it flying on with the ricochet spark and ping, and no muzzle flash at the wall.
now: In co-op you now see and hear your teammates rounds ricochet off steel, and he sees yours.
